reason: v2 froze 018 as an M1 platform cluster before its plan was run. Plan facts (2026-10-02, after ada5f0b): (1) InventoryV2LegacyMigration depends on src/infrastructure/storage/legacy_inventory_unit_allocator.js (cluster 020, game-application), so 018 cannot run before 020; no 020 module reads a 018 symbol, so 020 -> 018 is acyclic. (2) Policy: platform may depend only on engine, game-application-ports and platform, but InventoryItemSnapshotMapper and LegacyItemStateMigration import ITEM_PROGRESSION_CONFIG (game-config) and ItemFreshnessStatePolicy (game-domain), and InventoryV2LegacyMigration imports 10 game-domain modules, a game-config table and the 020 allocator: every one is a forbidden platform edge (records check: forbidden import). These five modules translate the save format (snapshot mapping, schema upgrades, legacy migration) and fit game-application (allowed: engine, game-config, game-domain, ports, application). (3) InventoryV2StateStore is the persistence boundary over an injected cache (its own doc: domain never depends on CacheManager); its only platform read is the hidden default `cache = typeof CacheManager !== 'undefined' ? CacheManager : null`, which no production site uses (InventoryV2CompositionRoot always passes `cache:` explicitly), and it owns INVENTORY_V2_SCHEMA_VERSION, read by the snapshot factory, the legacy migration and the composition root (application readers; application -> platform is forbidden). It moves with the other five to game-application; the concrete CacheManager (platform, cluster 036) stays injected by composition. InventoryV2LegacyMigration also reads ITEM_ASSEMBLY_PROFILE_CONFIG (src/game/config/raw, game-config-raw: not an allowed game-application dependency) to build its AssemblyProfileRegistry; the only production construction site (InventoryV2CompositionRoot) already holds that table and injects it in the preparation (constructor option, tests via constructor_defaults). Changes: 018 boundary platform -> game-application, milestone M1 -> M2, order 1 -> after 020; target paths src/game/application/inventory/persistence/; module set, tier (A) and all other clusters unchanged. M1 is now 019 + the M1 release.
